faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RRI Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Assistant post at Raman Research Institute is 05-10-2026. Ensure you complete all steps before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree or an Integrated M.Sc. degree in Physics or Mathematics to be eligible for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the RRI Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Research Assistant recruitment at Raman Research Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant post is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 31,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant position involves an initial screening followed by an interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position at Raman Research Institute is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Raman Research Institute (RRI).

faq.question: Q9. In which state and city is the Raman Research Institute located?
faq.answer: Raman Research Institute is located in Bangalore, Karnataka, with a pincode of 560080.

faq.question: Q10. What specific background is preferred for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: A strong background in General Relativity and Quantum Field Theory is required, along with experience and interest in numerical methods, particularly using C++.
